The developer homepage gitconnected.com && skilled.dev && levelup.dev Follow publication Member-only story Improving LangChain Knowledge Graph Extraction with BAML Fuzzy Parsing An end-to-end raw text-to-graph pipelines Fareed Khan 23 min read · 4 days ago -- 1 Share Read this story for free: link One of the biggest challenges when building knowledge graph-based RAG systems or agents with LangChain is getting accurate nodes and relationships from unstructured data. This is especially hard when using smaller, local LLMs that are quantized. As a result, the AI system often doesn’t perform well. Press enter or click to view image in full size Comparison between Langchain and baml (Created by Fareed Khan ) A key issue with LangChain extraction capabilities is its reliance on strict JSON parsing, which can fail even when using larger models or highly detailed prompt templates. In contrast, BAML uses a fuzzy parsing approach that can extract data even when the LLM output isn’t perfectly formatted as JSON. In this blog, we will explore the limitations of LangChain extraction when using smaller quantized models, and will see how BAML can improve extraction success rates from around 25% to over 99% .
